```{ojs}
//| label: Quezze
//| echo: false

// By removing the label parameter, the choices stack cleanly underneath the text
viewof user_answer = Inputs.radio([
  "77.70% (Without Continuity Correction) / 81.99% (With)",
  "85.20% (Without Continuity Correction) / 89.11% (With)",
  "68.30% (Without Continuity Correction) / 72.45% (With)",
  "91.05% (Without Continuity Correction) / 95.00% (With)"
])

viewof submit_btn = Inputs.button("Submit Answer")
md`${submit_btn > 0 ? checkAnswer(user_answer) : "_Select an option and click submit._"}`
function checkAnswer(selected) {
  const correctAnswer = "77.70% (Without Continuity Correction) / 81.99% (With)";
  if (selected === correctAnswer) {
    return "### ✅ Correct!"
  } else {
    return "### ❌ Incorrect";
  }
}
```
